title: Albuminuria detection using graphene oxide-mediated fluorescence quenching aptasensor
author: Chawjiraphan, Apiwat, et al.
materials: The albumin binding aptamer used in this paper was the 87-nucleotide ssDNA, which was selected based on our previous work [1], and was an HPLC grade material synthesized by Integrated DNA Technologies, Singapore. The sequence of the DNA aptamer was 5’/Cy5/ATA CCA GCT TAT TCA ATT CCC CCG GCT TTG GTT TAG AGG TAG TTG CTC ATT ACT TGT ACG CTC CGG ATG AGA TAG TAA GTG CAA TCT/3’. The fluorescence-labeled aptamers were dissolved in sterile water to make a stock solution of 100 µM, which was aliquoted and kept at -20°C until future use. The purified human albumin (A9731) was purchased from Sigma-Aldrich (St. Louis, Missouri, USA). The reduced GO monolayer powder was prepared using Hummers method and dissolved in sterile water to obtain 5 mg.mL−1 solution as described in our previous study [2]. The phosphate buffered saline (PBS) consisted of 137 mmol.L−1 NaCl, 2.7 mmol.L−1 KCL, 10 mmol.L−1 Na2HPO4, and 1.8 mmol.L−1 KH2PO4 (pH 7.4), and was autoclaved at 121°C for 15 min and kept at room temperature until use.

steps.title: Prepare Cy5‑labeled aptamer stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve the 87‑nt Cy5‑labeled ssDNA aptamer (sequence: 5’/Cy5/ATA CCA GCT TAT TCA ATT CCC CCG GCT TTG GTT TAG AGG TAG TTG CTC ATT ACT TGT ACG CTC CGG ATG AGA TAG TAA GTG CAA TCT/3’) in sterile water to a final concentration of 100 µM; aliquot and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Obtain purified human albumin
steps.instruction: Acquire purified human albumin (catalog number A9731) from Sigma‑Aldrich (St. Louis, Missouri, USA).

steps.title: Prepare reduced graphene oxide solution
steps.instruction: Using reduced GO monolayer powder prepared by the Hummers method, dissolve in sterile water to obtain a 5 mg·mL⁻¹ solution.

steps.title: Prepare autoclaved PBS buffer
steps.instruction: Make phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) containing 137 mmol·L⁻¹ NaCl, 2.7 mmol·L⁻¹ KCl, 10 mmol·L⁻¹ Na₂HPO₄, and 1.8 mmol·L⁻¹ KH₂PO₄; adjust pH to 7.4, autoclave at 121 °C for 15 min, then keep at room temperature until use.

steps.title: Collect and store urine specimens
steps.instruction: Collect 120 random spot urine samples in sterile screw‑cap tubes, aliquot each sample, and store at –80 °C until further use.
